title: Three Rounds
logline: Through the sacred ritual of three coffee rounds, an Ethiopian mother weaves together memory, family, and the enduring aroma of home across generations.

style.style_block: warm hand-painted gouache illustration, earthy browns, coffee-bean reds and soft golds, golden afternoon light through a window, gentle film grain, simple shapes, calm and intimate

characters.description: a generic Ethiopian woman in her fifties with a kind face, hair wrapped in a white cotton netela shawl with a thin woven border, wearing a white habesha dress with a woven tibeb trim

defaults.tts_style: warm, calm, unhurried, like an elder telling a family story

music.caption: Contemplative Ethiopian ballad led by delicate krar plucking, soulful masenqo phrasing, and warm, gentle acoustic string swells creating an intimate, nostalgic atmosphere.

cues.intent: Starts with solitary, gentle krar notes establishing quiet domestic intimacy and gradual anticipation.
Builds with warm cello chords and delicate masenqo accents as the gathering breathes with shared life.
Resolves into a full, resonant, and emotionally uplifting cadence evoking deep pride and homecoming.

shots.reason: Opens on the ritual being prepared (grass, incense, cups) in one shot, so the story reaches the roasting smoke sooner (User Test #1, P1).
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide view of the mother kneeling gracefully in the living room, scattering long blades of fresh green grass across the floor. Beside her rests a small clay incense burner with a thin, graceful plume of white smoke and a wooden tray of small white handle-less cups.
shots.motion_prompt: Incense smoke curls upward slowly as the camera pushes in gently toward the mother.
shots.narration: ቤቱ በቄጠማ ሲለብስ፣ የበረከቱ ጥሪ በዝምታ ይጀምራል።
shots.subtitle: When fresh grass dresses the floor, the quiet call of blessing begins.

shots.reason: Shows the first step of preparation, washing the green beans, which the audience asked to see (User Test #1, P1).
shots.image_prompt: Close-up centred on the mother's hands washing raw green coffee beans in a shallow bowl of clear water, droplets catching the window light, fresh green grass around the bowl.
shots.motion_prompt: Water ripples gently as the hands stir the beans; camera static.
shots.narration: በመጀመሪያ ጥሬው ቡና በንጹህ ውሃ ይታጠባል።
shots.subtitle: First, the green beans are washed in clean water.

shots.reason: Highlights the roasting smoke as the sensory beacon that summons loved ones without speaking.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot centered on the mother holding a round black roasting pan over glowing charcoal embers, shaking darkening coffee beans as thick, aromatic white smoke billows softly toward the window.
shots.motion_prompt: Coffee roasting smoke billows softly upward as the camera tilts up slowly.
shots.narration: የቡናው ጢስ ሲወጣ፣ መጥሪያ ደወል አያስፈልገውም።
shots.subtitle: When the roasted smoke rises, no words are needed to call us.

shots.reason: Shows how the aroma unites the household, drawing relatives out of separate spaces into shared warmth.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot looking across the room where dark silhouettes of family members step through doorways, drawn into the warm center where the mother sits enveloped in fragrant steam.
shots.motion_prompt: Silhouettes quietly step forward and gather while the camera remains static.
shots.narration: ከየክፍሉ አንድ በአንድ፣ ሽታው ሰብስቦ ያመጣናል።
shots.subtitle: From every room, the aroma draws us together one by one.

shots.reason: Shows grinding the roasted beans with the jebena boiling behind it: preparation detail plus a clear view of the jebena (User Test #1, P1 and P3).
shots.image_prompt: Centred medium close-up of the mother's hands pounding dark roasted coffee beans with a wooden pestle in a carved wooden mortar, a black clay jebena steaming on a small charcoal stove just behind.
shots.motion_prompt: Steam drifts from the jebena spout as the camera pulls out slowly.
shots.narration: የተቆላው ቡና በሙቀጫ ይወቀጣል፤ ጀበናውም ይፈላል።
shots.subtitle: The roasted beans are pounded, and the jebena comes to a boil.

shots.reason: Celebrates Abol, the first round that unlocks laughter, conversation, and collective connection.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot centered on the mother pouring an uninterrupted dark stream of coffee from the jebena high above into several small cups in sequence, a bowl of white popcorn resting beside the tray.
shots.motion_prompt: A continuous stream of dark coffee pours into cups as the camera pushes in slowly.
shots.narration: አቦል የመጀመሪያው ጽዋ፣ የጨዋታና የሳቅ መጀመሪያ ነው።
shots.subtitle: Abol, the first round, sparks our laughter and shared stories.

shots.reason: Captures the transmission of heritage across generations through the second cup.
shots.image_prompt: Centred close-up of a silhouette elder hand gently offering a warm porcelain cup of coffee into the small, eager hands of a young family member, steam rising between their palms.
shots.motion_prompt: Hands exchange the warm cup smoothly as the camera pans left slowly.
shots.narration: ቶና ሲደገም፣ የታሪኩ ፈትል ወደ ታናናሾቹ ይሻገራል።
shots.subtitle: With Tona, the thread of memory passes gently to younger hands.

shots.reason: Emphasizes the warmth of oral storytelling and quiet listening among family members.
shots.image_prompt: Medium composition centered on a carved wooden bowl heaped with white popcorn, surrounded by soft silhouettes and backs of listening family members seated closely, with the mother smiling softly in the background.
shots.motion_prompt: A silhouette hand reaches in to take popcorn while the camera holds static.
shots.narration: ያለፉት ቀናት ወጎች በልጆቹ ጆሮ ዳግም ህያው ይሆናሉ።
shots.subtitle: Timeless stories come alive once more in listening ears.

shots.reason: Delivers the emotional core of Bereka, blessing the family and safeguarding their bond.
shots.image_prompt: Centered medium shot of the mother holding the third cup with both hands against her heart, her face radiant with tenderness and devotion as she offers a silent maternal prayer.
shots.motion_prompt: The mother holds the cup securely as the camera pushes in slowly.
shots.narration: በረካ የመጨረሻው ምርቃት፣ ፍቅርንና ሰላምን ያትማል።
shots.subtitle: Bereka, the blessing cup, seals enduring love and peace.

shots.reason: Lands pride and warmth for family far from home; held longer so the final line and the rising smoke have room to settle (User Test #1, P2).
shots.image_prompt: Centered wide composition of the ceramic cups, the resting jebena, and sweet incense smoke rising gently into the golden window light, with the quiet silhouettes of the united family seated peacefully around.
shots.motion_prompt: Fragrant smoke rises in elegant spirals as the camera tilts up slowly.
shots.narration: በየትኛውም ምድር ብንኖር፣ ይሄ የቤታችን እና የትውስታችን ጠረን ነው።
shots.subtitle: Wherever we are in the world, this is what home smells like.
